landmarks.name: Quarto dei Mille
landmarks.note: Quarter of Genova. Garibaldi embarked here on 5 May 1860. The municipal comune named Quarto is a different town, in the province of Napoli.

gazetteer.name: New York
gazetteer.note: Migration endpoint. Ellis Island is the pin. This place is outside Italian jurisdiction.
